member.name: ThreadAffinity.Remarks
member.para: The controller invokes the host callbacks and drives its presentation on the thread of its dispatcher, which is the thread that owns the editor for a controller that serves a text area, so use it from that thread. A provider continuation can resume on a thread-pool thread when the thread that started the request has no synchronization context that posts to the dispatcher, so every publish goes through the dispatcher, even when the continuation already runs on the dispatcher's thread.
